verdict.rationale: Pylon has a dedicated Support Agent 'test' doc page for simulating interactions to see how the agent handles different questions before deployment, which satisfies the story's simulated-conversation path. Deployment also stays controlled because the agent only works on issues you explicitly assign it. Evidence is a single short doc line, though, and nothing shows the agent can be replayed or batch-evaluated against historical tickets. Missing for 10: testing against historical tickets, detail on simulation depth (multi-turn, actions, scenario sets), independent or hands-on corroboration.
